title: jgates.yml
description: Entry point of the JGates configuration: profile, templates and general overrides.

schemaVersion.description: 2 since the container-first release (execution.runner removed); a schema 1 document is read through the migration reader.

gates.description: The gates a run selects: quality, semantic or both (Quality always runs first; Semantic starts only after a complete, current, non-reduced Quality approval). Default: quality.

qualityCoverage.description: declared-scope (default): a fully completed scoped Quality run approves the scope it declared when it covers the Semantic subjects. repository: only a Quality run that covered the whole repository approves.

files.description: Configuration evidence (same as match.files of a template): at least one of these files must exist in the root of a component of the matched languages, or in the workspace root.

dataMaxAgeDays.description: Advisory data (vulnerability databases of the offline scanners) older than this many days makes the checks that read it incomplete (DATA_STALE). A governed policy can require less. Default 7.

extensionImage.description: jgates ci only: what the policy accepts of extension images. forbid: any extension (the project's .jgates/image or a tool on another image) is refused. pinned: the extension images must be named by their sha256 digest and the tools image of the job must be the one pinned by this JGates (release/tools-image.json). Absent: the job runs the tools image alone and extensions are not looked at.

failFast.description: Stop at the first failed stage; the rest is recorded as not run.

trustSelfReported.description: jgates ci only: whether a stage whose result the analyzed project controls (its tests, its build, a command that runs its code) may satisfy a requirement on its own. Default false: such a stage can fail the run but never approves it alone.

budgets.description: Limits of one run. Declared by the repository; the plan shows them.

services.description: The project's compose services for integration, e2e, API contract, DAST and migration checks. A run starts them as its own compose project (labels, project folders mounted read-only, no published ports), the checks that need them join its network, and it is always taken down afterwards.

compose.description: Compose files, project-relative, in order; default: the files Compose itself finds.

start.description: Services to start; default: the target and the services the checks name.

target.description: The application under test (api-contract, dast, e2e).

health.description: Polled until it answers 2xx/3xx, after the compose healthchecks.

build.description: May compose build images from the project's Dockerfiles (default forbid).

writableBinds.description: Services allowed to write to the project folder (refused in governed mode).

allowHostEffects.description: Host effects a governed run accepts (the policy decides).

timeoutSeconds.description: Wait for the healthchecks and the target's health path (default 120).
